name: Expedition Salvation

faq.answer: Williden Marshal leads an expedition into Un'Goro Crater and awaits these provisions.
You carry a crate of foodstuffs and research equipment to the camp in Un'Goro Crater.
The expedition is stationed inside Un'Goro Crater, where the supplies must be delivered.

sections.body: Williden Marshal waits within Un'Goro Crater for essential supplies. You recover a crate of foodstuffs and research equipment from the base camps his party fled and bring them back to his camp, where the survival of his party depends on what you deliver.
sections.title: Supplies for the Crater

summary: Williden Marshal needs critical supplies delivered to his camp inside Un'Goro Crater. You carry a crate of foodstuffs and research equipment to aid the expedition.
